actions.message: Contribute 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is well above 50% of the initial endowment, so the constitution requires the baseline 80% contribution this round. It's also a broadcast round (every 5 rounds), so a norm reminder is sent.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round 15? Actually observation round=15, we need decide for round 16. Wallet 6424.7. >50% so baseline 80% contribution = 0.8*6424.7 = 5139.76. No broadcast (broadcast every 5 rounds: rounds 1,6,11,16?). round 1 broadcast, 6, 11, 16. So round 16 should broadcast. Also check free rider condition: need any agent contributed <10% two consecutive rounds. Look at recent rounds contributions_by_agent: round15 Resident2 0, Resident2 contributed 0 (<10%). Round14 Resident2 0 as well. That's two consecutive rounds of <10%. So punish Resident2 with amount 10 (cost 3). We can do one physical action only; we must choose either contribute or punish or rest. Constitution says punish free-riders. Should punish. But also need contribution baseline 80%? Rule says baseline contribution each round, but we can only one physical action. Which takes priority? Constitution: Contribute Generously is first rule. Punish is third. So prioritize contribution. But we also must punish free-riders per rule. Conflict. Need decide. Probably we can still contribute and also punish? But only one physical action allowed. Need choose. I'd pick contribution as primary. However punish is mandatory when condition met. Might override. I'd choose contribution and maybe skip punish. Explanation accordingly.
